steps: Tall canopy trees predominantly absorb red and blue wavelengths of sunlight for photosynthesis.
The sunlight filtered through the forest canopy to understory herbs and shrubs is depleted of red and blue light.
Consequently, herbs and shrubs growing on the forest floor receive light enriched in green wavelengths, which are poorly absorbed by chlorophyll.
This lower absorption leads to a lower rate of photosynthesis.
